rationale: All 5 findings from the final review are resolved. CR-001 closed by product owner confirmation that port is required for all dialects including InfluxDB — no code change required. CR-002 fixed by adding a canonical-form guard (v === String(parseInt(v, 10))) to the port range test, rejecting leading-zero strings such as '007'. CR-003 fixed by adding tests for username and password validation covering both required (postgres) and optional (influxdb) branches. CR-004 fixed by adding tests for org and bucket validation covering both required (influxdb) and optional (postgres) branches. CR-005 fixed by adding 'rejects empty port' test exercising validate('') and validate(undefined). Fix-up changes introduce no new security surface or public API changes.

standards_review.notes: Carried forward from final review. Fix-up changes are test additions and a validation tightening — no new security surface introduced.

finding_status.notes: Product owner confirmed port is required for all SQL dialects including InfluxDB. No code change required; original behaviour is correct.

Added v === String(parseInt(v, 10)) condition to the port-range .test() in settingsUIConfig.ts:565. Leading-zero strings like '007' now fail with 'Port must be between 1 and 65535'. New 'rejects leading-zero ports' test confirms the fix.
Added 'requires username and password for generic SQL dialects' test covering postgres (rejects empty) and influxdb (resolves empty) branches for both usernameValidation and passwordValidation.
Added 'requires org and bucket for influxdb' test covering influxdb (rejects empty) and postgres (resolves empty) branches for both orgValidation and bucketValidation.
Added 'rejects empty port' test asserting portValidation.validate('') and portValidation.validate(undefined) both reject with 'Port is required'.
